name: sir-bootstrap
brief: Bootstrap SIR for DM Auth. Add .sir/config.json (the plugin template with disciplines wired), seven self-contained discipline fragments under .sir/disciplines/ (csharp-style, dotnet, efcore, dotnet-tests, client-tests, typescript-style, react) and a .gitignore entry for .claude-worktrees/. Port every rule of the eight docs/ convention files into those fragments, proven by a per-task port ledger kept with the session records, fold in five memory-only conventions, then delete the eight docs and repoint README. docs/architecture-decisions.md stays. No code, test or workflow change: the session touches exactly 18 paths.
